notes: Final contact revision uses every original part, including wheel lateral envelopes, with priority-1 stiff floor constraints. Generic box/capsule/cylinder floor contacts are disabled. Preliminary 69-part and combined-proxy revisions are retained separately; neither is the final contact experiment.
Initial root pose set once before the first physics step. No root resets or external forces thereafter.
First 0.75 s holds hips at 0.1 rad and wheels at zero; matched idle repeats that command for all six seconds.
extend strategies sweep both hips from 0.02 to 0.62 rad and use opposite signs of 0.03 Nm wheel torque.
rock uses a 0.8 s triangular hip sweep and signed alternating wheel torque; asymmetric uses opposite hip sweeps and opposite wheel torque.
When tilt is below 20 degrees and both wheels loaded, switch to low-stance v5 balance adaptation; loss above 35 degrees resumes the declared recovery until 3.5 s.
At 3.5 s, wheel recovery torque stops unless captured. All trials finish at six seconds.
This is a bounded deterministic command study, not proof of mechanical impossibility or original firmware behavior.
